itemId.description: UUID v4 of the item to retrieve. Must come from an itemId returned by a previous listing call with resultKind=ITEM, or from the `featuredItems` of `getMerchant`. Do not invent or guess item IDs.

merchantId.description: UUID v4 of the merchant that owns the item. Must come from a merchantId returned by a previous listing call (browseOffers, searchOffers, or getRecommendations) or from `getMerchant`. Do not invent or guess merchant IDs.
UUID v4 of the merchant to retrieve. Must come from a merchantId returned by a previous listing call (browseOffers, searchOffers, or getRecommendations). Do not invent or guess merchant IDs.

experiment.description: Optional A/B experiment identifier that selects which search pipeline should be used for this request.

includeFacets.description: When true, includes refinement buckets in facets (price, distance, taxonomy, etc.). Defaults to false.

intention.description: Optional intention to guide search results. When omitted, derived from resultKind (MERCHANT → 'merchant', ITEM → 'product').

merchantType.description: Restricts the search to an iFood business unit. When absent, the search crosses all verticals.

nextPageToken.description: Opaque token from the previous response to fetch the next page. Do not invent tokens.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default 10, maximum 25.

query.description: Free-text user intent — only the descriptive/content part. Qualifiers (price, distance, etc.) go in `refinements`.

refinements.description: Semantic filters and ordering. All fields are optional. Conversational mapping: 'cheap' → maxItemPrice + sort:PRICE; 'nearby' → maxDistanceKm + sort:DISTANCE; 'free delivery' → maxDeliveryFee:0 + sort:DELIVERY_FEE; 'fast / within X minutes' → maxDeliveryTimeMinutes + sort:DELIVERY_TIME; 'well-rated' → minRating + sort:RATING; 'open now' → onlyOpen:true; 'with promotion / on sale' → onlyWithPromotion:true.

itemRestrictions.description: Dietary/nutritional item restrictions. For resultKind=ITEM only. Conversational mapping: 'vegan' → VEGAN; 'lactose-free' → LAC_FREE; 'gluten-free' → GLUTEN_FREE.

itemTaxonomy.description: Optional. String array of taxonomy ids from facets in a prior response; do not invent values. Each string is either a single level-2 id (no slash) or parent/child as "level2/level3" with exactly one slash. Several slash-free ids mean results may match any of those level-2 categories. Strings with more than one slash are skipped.

maxDeliveryTimeMinutes.description: Maximum delivery time ceiling (minutes), applied to deliveryTimeMinutes.max of the quoted delivery method.

maxDistanceKm.description: Maximum geodesic distance to the merchant (km).

maxItemPrice.description: Maximum item price (BRL). For resultKind=MERCHANT, returns merchants with at least one item within this limit.

maxMinimumOrderAmount.description: Ceiling for the merchant's minimum order amount (BRL), zero or greater. Keeps merchants whose minimum is at or below this value; a merchant that reports no minimum always passes. Independent of maxItemPrice and maxDeliveryFee — each caps its own value, none caps their sum.

merchantId.description: UUID v4. Restricts results to this merchant. For resultKind=ITEM, canonical path to search or browse within a store after the user picks a merchant (combine with merchantType when needed).

onlyOpen.description: If true, returns only merchants that are currently open.

onlyWithPromotion.description: If true, returns only promotional content. With resultKind=MERCHANT, merchants with an active voucher; with resultKind=ITEM, items with a promotional price.

sort.description: Ordering: RELEVANCE (default), DELIVERY_FEE, DELIVERY_TIME, DISTANCE, PRICE.

resultKind.description: Desired result type: MERCHANT (stores) or ITEM (items/products). Defaults to MERCHANT when omitted.

cartId.description: The cart ID from a previous createCart or getCart response
The cart ID from a previous createCart or getCart response

code.description: The voucher code to apply, as returned by the listVouchers tool

campaignId.description: The campaign ID of the voucher, as returned by the listVouchers tool.
